fields.title: 2. Also Read — Thanksgiving Press Release (2026-11-16) · Form 4 (2026-11-19)
fields.md:
- **Press release text** (source: [nov1626.pdf](https://www.berkshirehathaway.com/news/nov1626.pdf), 2026-11-16): conversion of 6,150 Class A shares → 9,225,000 Class B shares · four foundations (Susan Thompson Buffett 3,690,000 shares · Sherwood, Howard G. Buffett and NoVo 1,845,000 shares each) · after the donation 182,140 Class A shares and 1,162 Class B shares. Not a single figure differs from 13D/A No. 82 in the previous issue (cross-check: [13D/A No. 82](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526465884/xslSCHEDULE_13D_X02/primary_doc.xml)).
- Buffett's statement in the press release — to the effect that he plans to donate all of his Berkshire shares to the four foundations — is recorded **only as a milestone candidate** under Rule 1 of the protocol (state.manager_statements_as_milestone_candidates_only). It is not used as a basis for judgment. If this statement comes true, the 29.6% voting power (No. 82) would shift toward the foundations over time or be diluted by Class B conversion — an observation target for Axis E, but since no timing is set, it is not made a milestone (judgment, sources: [press release](https://www.berkshirehathaway.com/news/nov1626.pdf) · [13D/A No. 82](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526465884/xslSCHEDULE_13D_X02/primary_doc.xml)).
- **Form 4** (source: [Form 4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526468887/xslF345X06/ownership.xml), signed 2026-11-19): director Charlotte Guyman gifted 400 Class B shares on 2026-11-17 (code G, price $0), leaving 2,488 Class B shares held directly after the transaction. It is unrelated to the company's equity and share count (judgment).
